title: Pantry cupboard with tray dividers
summary: A freestanding pantry cupboard with shelves, tray dividers and two open cubbies at the bottom.
intro: A tall pantry cupboard for a kitchen that needed more storage. Shelves for jars and tins at the top, upright dividers for trays and boards, and two open cubbies at the bottom. Two framed doors close it all away, and it stands on legs.

cover.alt: MDF pantry cupboard with both doors open, shelves and tray dividers inside
